cases.name: Tanuel "Daisy" Major
cases.about:
From her obituary:

"Tanuel Major was born December 15, 1968 in Chicago, Illinois to the union of Amanda and LeAndrew Major. She was one of four children to bless this union. Tanuel was a phenomenal big sister putting the needs of her siblings before her own and nurturing them as only a big sister can do. She provided an example to follow in love, family and devotion to care.

Tanuel received her formal education in -Chicago, Illinois. As a young adult she moved to California and continued her education. Her love of people led her to pursue a career in medicine.

Tanuel was blessed with two children Tyler and Tabbie. She enjoyed being a mom. She was a momma bear, ferocious in her devotion and zealous in her pursuit of excellence for her children needs. Her love of her children knew no bounds. She worked hard to give her children a firm education and spiritual foundation enabling them to have the academic tools to pursue all their dreams. Tanuel Major was smart and resourceful. She worked as a clerical worker in the financial field to care for her family."
cases.narrative: Beaten to death with trauma to the head. Her body was found in an alcove at the First United Methodist Church at Church Street and Hinman Avenue. She had laid there to sleep.
